GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (15 Oct 45) CCS
(SCAPIN - 145)
APO 500
15 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Establishment of Additional Broadcast Stations for Armed Forces Radio Service.
1. There is a need for additional radio broadcast service to occupation troops in the cities of Matsuyama, Tsuruga and Okayama. It is desired that the Broadcast Corporation install additional stations having a power output between 100-500 watts at these locations and operate these stations for the Armed Forces Radio Service programs originated in Tokyo. These stations are required to be in operation 22 October.
2. Details of this project should be coordinated with the Civil Communications Section of this headquarters.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
